Tooltip_XNPPurpleLifeStockRecorder: Legacy compatibility item. It is migrated once and is never granted automatically.
Tooltip_XNPPurpleLifeStockBackup: Choose Use Extra Life Backup from the context menu, or double-click. It is consumed only after a successful restore.
Tooltip_XNPYellowAltCrowdBreakout: On the bound Run-key press, gently pushes nearby zombies only during strong control or a dangerous crowd of at least three. It deals no damage and never reverses existing damage.
Tooltip_XNPDeveloperTestTools: Test-build only and disabled by default. It creates only XNP-owned damaged test items, and cleanup never deletes ordinary items.
